C0164.title: First Game Cheat Case for Tencent's Delta Force Cracked
C0164.summary: In 2024, the first cheat case involving Tencent's Delta Force was cracked. The suspect Xie tampered with the game's source code to create a cheat program for iOS featuring wallhacks and aimbots, selling it online and making nearly 60,000 yuan in illegal profits.

references.title: First Tencent 'Delta Force' Game Cheat Case Cracked, Over 1,300 Accounts Using the Tech Banned
